# Pokemon Ichor repository instructions

Start with [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the team handbook
[CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md). The shared engineering contract and validation matrix
are in [design/ENGINEERING.md](../design/ENGINEERING.md).

Use the assigned checkout/branch, trace the owning mechanism and its callers,
and reuse documented Ichor APIs. Preserve gameplay and saves. Add regression
evidence for behavior changes; never silently skip failed or unavailable checks.
Assisted progression tests do not establish natural-level balance or human approval.
